# ShaderParameter

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Graphics` · class

```csharp
public sealed class ShaderParameter
```

Represents a handle to a shader uniform parameter.

## Remarks

`ShaderParameter` instances are lightweight handles that reference parameters owned by a [`Shader`](Shader.md). They do not independently own resources and should not be disposed. The underlying resources are released when the owning [`Shader`](Shader.md) is disposed.

Obtain instances via [`Shader.GetParameter`](Shader.md#getparameter).
